scoutPriorityAction: ** Draft and schedule three posts today — Hug Your Dog Day (April 10), National Pet Day (April 11), and the Dog Bite Prevention Week safety post (April 12) — pulling directly from existing client testimonials on personalized care and rehab support.

content.instagram_post_copy:
POST 1 — Schedule for April 10 (National Hug Your Dog Day)

This one is for the dogs who make the whole day better.

Every dog we walk in Williamsburg and Greenpoint has a person behind them who trusts us with the leash. That is not something we take lightly — and days like today are a good reminder of why we got into this in the first place.

If your dog is part of our crew: they are seen, they are cared for, and yes, they are definitely getting extra attention today.

DM us if you want to get your dog on the schedule. 🐾

#HugYourDogDay #WilliamsburgDogs #NotTheRug


POST 2 — Schedule for April 11 (National Pet Day)

We started this in 2011 because Williamsburg dogs deserved better than whoever was free that day.

Fifteen years later, the thing clients tell us most is that their dog finally has a walker who actually knows them — their pace, their quirks, their favorite block to slow down on.

That kind of familiarity does not happen by accident. It happens because we keep the same people on the same dogs, and we pay attention.

Happy National Pet Day to every dog on our route. You are all doing great.

Reach out to get started — link in bio.

#NationalPetDay #WilliamsburgDogs #NotTheRug


POST 3 — Schedule for April 12 (Dog Bite Prevention Week)

Dog Bite Prevention Week starts today. Here is what our safety model actually looks like on the ground.

No pack walks. Solo or small familiar groups only — dogs are not anonymous to us.

Double leash on every walk. Not just for reactive dogs. For everyone.

GPS tracking on every outing. You know where your dog is. We know where your dog is.

We also work with dogs recovering from surgery or managing ongoing needs. The clients who come to us for that level of care are often the ones who have been burned by a platform that sent someone different every time.

Consistency is not a perk. For some dogs, it is the whole thing.

DM us if your dog needs a walker who will actually learn them.

#DogBitePreventionWeek #WilliamsburgDogs #NotTheRug
content.content_angle: This is a three-post scheduled package built to capture three consecutive high-visibility days — April 10, 11, and 12 — without conflating them or blurring the brand message across the run. Each post does a different job. The Hug Your Dog Day post is a low-lift reach driver: warm, photo-ready, neighborhood-rooted, designed to pull engagement from existing followers and their networks without asking much of them. The National Pet Day post is a quiet credibility play — it uses the brand's founding year and the testimonial signal around personalized, consistent care to make an identity claim that earns the day rather than just marking it. The Dog Bite Prevention Week post is the operational trust anchor: it names the specific safety practices (solo walks, double leash, GPS) that differentiate Not The Rug from platform-style services, and it opens the door to the surgical rehab and special needs client segment that Scout flagged as underserved and high-intent in the Williamsburg and Greenpoint market. Taken together, the three posts move a prospective client from warmth to familiarity to trust — the same arc most new clients need before they hand over the leash.
